shots.prompt: Wide shot. The woman frantically lifts the sofa cushions one by one, searching, and says: "Where is the remote?"
Close-up of the Shiba Inu sitting on the sofa, deadpan. The dog says in a deep calm deadpan male voice: "Have you tried... looking?" Then its mouth closes.
Medium shot. The woman throws her hands up, frustrated: "I looked everywhere. Under the sofa. In the fridge."
shots.en: I looked everywhere. Under the sofa. In the fridge.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the Shiba Inu, one ear tilting. The dog says in the deep voice: "The fridge?" Then its mouth closes.
The woman shrugs defensively: "Last time it was in the fridge." Then a live studio audience laughs.
shots.en: Last time it was in the fridge.

shots.prompt: The living room, the woman now on her hands and knees. No people speak. A short upbeat 1990s sitcom slap-bass transition riff plays, then fades to silence.
The woman lies on the floor shining a small flashlight under the low TV cabinet, searching. No dialogue. The dog watches silently from the sofa, mouth closed.
Close-up of the Shiba Inu on the sofa, deadpan. The dog says in the deep voice: "Warmer." Then its mouth closes.
The woman stands up hopefully and walks toward the kitchen doorway, asking: "Here?"
Close-up of the Shiba Inu, deadpan. The dog says in the deep voice: "Colder. Much colder." Then its mouth closes and the studio audience laughs.
Evening, the warm orange floor lamp glows in the living room. No people speak. A short upbeat 1990s sitcom slap-bass transition riff plays.
The woman drops onto the sofa next to the dog, exhausted, and sighs: "Fine. No TV tonight. We'll just talk."
shots.en: Fine. No TV tonight. We'll just talk.
shots.ko: 됐어. 오늘은 TV 없어. 그냥 대화나 하자.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the Shiba Inu, eyes widening slightly. The dog says quickly in the deep voice: "I'll help you look." Then its mouth closes.
The Shiba Inu stands up on the sofa. A black TV remote control is revealed on the cushion exactly where the dog was sitting. Both stare at it in silence, mouths closed. No dialogue.
Close-up of the woman, pointing at the remote in disbelief: "You were sitting on it?!"
Close-up of the Shiba Inu, calm and deadpan. The dog says in the deep voice: "It was warm. I was keeping it safe." Then its mouth closes and the studio audience laughs.
shots.en: It was warm. I was keeping it safe.

shots.prompt: The woman grabs the remote and narrows her eyes at the dog: "For how long?"
Close-up of the Shiba Inu, deadpan. The dog says in the deep voice: "Since Tuesday." Then its mouth closes and the studio audience bursts into laughter.

Wide shot. The woman and the dog sit side by side watching the boxy CRT TV. The dog slowly places one paw on the remote, mouths closed. The studio audience laughs and applauds, then a short upbeat 1990s sitcom slap-bass outro riff plays. No dialogue.
